text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty page fired — inference-service/us-east-1 p50/p95 latency spike detected. symptom: sudden tail latency (5-10s) for text-generation requests. alert_id=PD-88321. link: https://pd.incidents/PD-88321

pagerbot: auto-ack by alex (oncall). incident assigned INC-2026-88321. escalation policy: primary->secondary after 3m.

alex: I have the page, jumping in. grabbing logs and traces now.

saira: on standby to assist. will start a quick mitigation plan: scale pool + enable degraded routing if needed.

alex: quick check — p50 jumped from ~200ms to 3.1s, p95 ~8s. Error rate small but tail latency huge for long-context requests.

lina: customer impact: some customers in us-east-1 seeing timeouts and delayed responses; CS ticketing team alerted. Marking as potential customer-visible.

alex: running a manual scale: bump dedicated pool from 6->12 replicas, concurrent_requests from 8->12. kicking off now.

pagerbot: autoscaler event: desired_replicas=12, reason="manual-scale-request by alex".

alex: enabling degraded routing policy to route new heavy requests to model-variant:vsmall to keep latency bounded. config snippet:```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"model-variant:vsmall","min_tokens":16}```

saira: adding KV-cache warmup for hot prefixes, increasing cache TTL from 30s->120s to reduce eviction churn. pushing change to staging then prod.

tim: brief handoff note — if this persists past the hour i'll take the bridge for coverage. for now i'll monitor metrics and watch for PD re-escalation.

alex: logs show spike coincides with a burst of long-context requests from a single customer IP block. starting IP-based rate cap at edge to contain blast radius.

cust-liaison: informing top-5 affected customers and posting ETA: 15-30m. CSMs looped in.

lina: adding incident tag sev=2 and impact=partial. recording initial customer list in the incident doc.

pagerbot: health update — p50 improved to 320ms, p95 ~1.2s after scale+routing. error rate falling.

alex: continuing to watch. rolling back IP cap if stable. plan for postmortem: validate KV cache TTL and autoscaler thresholds.

saira: follow-ups: (1) tune cache TTLs, (2) add prefix-aware prewarming, (3) add PD alert for sustained p95>2s for >5m.

tim: agreed. if stable for next 15m i'll hand over to next oncall with notes.

pagerbot: incident INC-2026-88321 status: acknowledged -> mitigated. awaiting confirmation to resolve.

alex: confirming mitigation holding. p95 now ~900ms and decreasing. no new PD re-fires. handing to tim in 10m with runbook link: https://wiki/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-88321

tim: taking ownership for monitoring window and write-up. leaving a short checklist in the doc.

cust-liaison: customers notified: initial notification sent, will send closure message after 1h if stable.

lina: adding RCA stub: suspected KV cache eviction storm + single-customer traffic burst. will prioritize follow-up.

alex: thanks everyone. closing active mitigation. will add logs+traces to the incident later. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: incident INC-2026-88321 marked resolved by tim.
